user_id AS userId, theme, notif_trip AS notifTrip, notif_tips AS notifTips, notif_charging AS notifCharging, notif_weekly AS notifWeekly, move_mode AS moveMode, gps_scale AS gpsScale, demo_scale AS demoScale, goal_kg AS goalKg, battery_pct AS batteryPct, active_vehicle_id AS activeVehicleId, notif_read AS notifRead, share_location AS shareLocation
